description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'MessageTest' for the 'Message' model within the Goteo project. It tests the creation, validation, language support, listing, deletion, and retrieval of message objects, including interactions with related user and project entities.

classes.name: MessageTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Message model functionality in the Goteo project.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up language configuration before any tests run.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of a Message object.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation and save methods of the Message object.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Message object with test data, validates, saves, and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Tests setting a language-specific translation for a message.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Checks that language-specific message translations are retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testListing
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all messages for a project, including language-specific listings.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes a message object and tests the deletion process.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving and deleting a non-existing message.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up test data, including test projects, users, and nodes.
